media.description: Promotional cover for Kind, ich freu’ mich auf Dein Kommen (1933), documenting the Bronisław Kaper–Walter Jurmann collaboration.
media.altText: Vintage promotional cover for “Kind, ich freu’ mich auf Dein Kommen” (1933).
media.rightsNote: The Walter Jurmann cover gallery documents this German promotional cover but supplies no open reuse licence. A graphic work published in Germany in 1933 remained protected on 1 January 1996, so United States copyright was restored under the URAA. The local image is classified as restricted.
